name: Leman Copley
role: Former Shaker convert who owned land at Thompson, Ohio
dateNote: Section 49 sent him to the Shakers in May 1831, and by June he had broken his land agreement.
importance: Leman Copley was a former Shaker who joined the Church by 1831. He offered land at Thompson, Ohio, where the Colesville Saints settled. Section 49 sends him with Sidney Rigdon and Parley P. Pratt to preach to the Shakers, teaching only what they teach him. After that mission he went back on the agreement and ordered the Colesville members off his land, the event behind section 54.
connections: He deals with Sidney Rigdon, Parley P. Pratt, and the Colesville branch led by Newel Knight.

sources.title: Leman Copley, Joseph Smith Papers biography

reviewNote: JSP gives birth ca. 1781 in Connecticut and death at Madison, Ohio, with an obituary of 3 July 1862; exact death date not given. Named only as “Leman” in 49:1, 4.
